prompts.title: Sophisticated Gentleman Look
prompts.prompt:
Create a premium, ultra-realistic 4:5 vertical editorial portrait of the uploaded male subject, preserving his natural facial identity, facial proportions, age, skin tone, hairstyle, hairline, eye shape, and facial hair exactly as shown in the reference. Do not beautify, reshape, age, de-age, or add/remove facial hair.
Frame him in a centered waist-up composition, standing upright and facing the camera with squared, level shoulders. His arms are folded firmly but naturally across his torso: one forearm forms a clean horizontal line across the body with the wristwatch clearly visible on the viewer’s left, while the opposite hand rests naturally on the upper arm. Keep both elbows and the complete folded-arm pose inside the frame. His head remains straight with a neutral chin position, direct eye contact, relaxed closed lips, and a calm, serious, self-assured expression conveying quiet authority and refined executive confidence.
Dress him in a perfectly tailored charcoal-grey blazer featuring a subtle micro-check or Prince-of-Wales pattern, structured shoulders, broad notched lapels, a single-breasted two-button front, and detailed four-button sleeve cuffs. Underneath, he wears a fitted medium-grey ribbed turtleneck with a neatly folded high collar. Add a crisp white pocket square arranged elegantly in the breast pocket and narrow white shirt cuffs subtly visible beneath the blazer sleeves. Complete the styling with a sophisticated classic wristwatch featuring a polished gold case, minimal white dial, and dark brown leather strap. The tailoring should look realistic, with accurate fabric texture, natural folds, clean seams, and a premium fitted silhouette.
Place him in front of an elegant modern building entrance or upscale architectural interior. Keep the background heavily blurred, featuring dark charcoal and black structural surfaces, a soft neutral-grey column on the left, and several warm amber circular lights creating creamy bokeh on the right. The environment should feel luxurious and understated without recognizable objects, text, or logos.
Use soft directional light from slightly above and in front of the subject, gently defining the cheekbones, jawline, eyes, and fabric texture without harsh shadows. Add subtle frontal fill for balanced facial exposure and delicate separation from the dark background. Maintain realistic skin pores, natural complexion variation, individual hair strands, detailed eyes, and authentic fabric texture without excessive smoothing or artificial sharpening.
Capture at eye level with an 85mm portrait lens at approximately f/1.8–f/2.2, producing natural facial proportions, sharp focus on the face and clothing, and a smooth shallow depth of field. Apply a sophisticated cinematic colour grade dominated by charcoal and neutral grey tones, restrained warm amber highlights, slightly warm natural skin tones, rich blacks, and polished editorial contrast. High-end luxury menswear campaign, executive portrait photography, photorealistic, refined, timeless and professionally retouched while remaining completely natural.
Avoid a tight crop, casual smile, exaggerated muscles, distorted arms or fingers, uneven shoulders, warped lapels, incorrect watch placement, plastic skin, excessive HDR, distracting background details, text, logos, or watermarks.

prompts.title: The Modern Business Portrait
prompts.prompt:
Ultra-realistic cinematic portrait of a confident man seated in a luxurious armchair inside a refined, dark wood-paneled room. The subject is captured in a slightly three-quarter view, in a relaxed yet powerful posture. He sits slightly reclined, legs apart, with his left arm resting naturally on the armrest and his right hand raised near the face in a gesture of calm confidence, as if reflecting or about to speak. His expression conveys authority, composure, and leadership — exuding the aura of a successful entrepreneur or visionary professional. The subject wears a tailored dark gray suit with a black dress shirt underneath, no tie, blending modern elegance and subtle dominance. The suit should display realistic fabric texture and natural folds, emphasizing sophistication. His shoes are polished, matching the tone of the outfit, complementing the overall refined look. The environment is illuminated with warm cinematic lighting — soft key light from the front-left, accentuating facial contours and casting smooth shadows. Background lighting highlights the wood-paneled wall behind him, with rich brown tones and subtle reflections, creating an atmosphere of luxury and focus. The armchair is plush and upholstered in gray velvet, detailed with realistic fabric texture and depth, harmonizing perfectly with the warm ambiance of the room. On his wrist, a metallic watch subtly reflects light, adding a touch of realism and prestige. A small side table with metallic or glass details may appear partially visible on the right side of the frame, reinforcing the elegant and executive mood. Camera setup: 50mm or 85mm lens, mid-distance shot, cinematic depth of field with soft background blur. The composition is balanced and symmetrical for the subject's visual dominance.
Style: ultra-realistic photography, 8K resolution, cinematic tone, professional studio color grading, volumetric warm light, detailed textures, subtle contrast. Perfect for portraying authority, luxury, and strategic mindset.
4:5 aspect ratio.

prompts.title: Portrait of Power
prompts.prompt:
Create an ultra-realistic, cinematic 8K medium portrait of a confident male with a powerful, athletic physique, embodying a refined “quiet luxury” aesthetic. Use the uploaded image strictly ONLY for 100% accurate face matching and identity reference. The subject has neatly styled hair and a well-groomed appearance, with smooth, healthy-looking skin.
Composition: Centered chest-up portrait with symmetrical framing. The subject fills approximately 75–80% of the frame, creating a strong, commanding presence. Vertical 4:5 aspect ratio.
Outfit: A perfectly tailored monochromatic all-black suit featuring a structured blazer, crisp black dress shirt, and matte black necktie. A luxury stainless-steel chronograph watch with a black dial is visible on the left wrist.
Pose: Standing upright with broad shoulders and arms confidently crossed across the chest. Posture is strong, composed, and authoritative.
Expression & Gaze: Serious, calm, and self-assured expression. Maintaining direct eye contact with the camera for a powerful and commanding presence.
Background: Seamless deep-black studio backdrop with no visible texture, distractions, or environmental elements, creating a dramatic minimalist atmosphere.

A soft directional key light from the viewer's left creates a subtle triangle of illumination on the shadowed cheek, producing rich chiaroscuro contrast. Gentle highlights define the jawline, cheekbones, and facial contours while preserving natural skin tones. Fine suit fabric textures and watch details remain visible without overexposure.
Camera: Eye-level perspective, 85mm portrait lens, shallow depth of field at f/1.8.
Technical Details: Ultra-realistic, photorealistic, cinematic color grading, DSLR-level clarity, hyper-detailed skin texture, realistic fabric weave, sharp focus on the eyes, high dynamic range, premium luxury editorial style, ultra-sharp 8K resolution, professional fashion campaign quality.
